caption_original:
My final year project revealed a surprising market trend I hadn't anticipated. Let’s discuss.

During my final year project, focused on analyzing consumer behavior within the sustainable fashion sector, I uncovered a significant shift – a growing demand for upcycled denim jackets incorporating QR codes linking to detailed production information. This wasn’t a predicted outcome of our initial research.

The project involved extensive data collection through surveys and interviews with young adults interested in ethical consumption. We meticulously analyzed existing market data alongside this primary research.

It was a challenging but incredibly rewarding experience, pushing me to adapt my research methodology and really dig into consumer motivations. I’m particularly interested in hearing how other students tackled unexpected findings in their projects.

What surprising trends have you uncovered during your final year work? #finalyearproject #sustainablefashion #research #consumerbehaviour #innovation
